data.name: Eccentric Wander
data.detailed_description:
• Despite the genuinely horror atmosphere, the protagonists are carefree!

    It's a horror game, but with a lighthearted tone. But people do die when their time comes.

  • The game's progression changes depending on your partner's life/death and affection level! You can even choose not to bring a partner!

    For those who think a partner isn't necessary in a horror game, you can choose not to bring one. Very considerate.

    Your partner can die, but the story progresses regardless.

    Your partner has an affection level, which increases or decreases depending on choices and items you give them.

    Dialogue and expressions change depending on the affection level, and the story progression also changes.

  • You can name your protagonist and partner!

    Name them after yourself, your friends, family, or even something silly.

  • You can dress up your partner!

    From humorous to sexy outfits.

    More outfits become available as you meet various conditions.

  • There are multiple ways to play!

    You can defeat enemies! You can use stealth! You can solve puzzles!

  • You can cook!

    Gather ingredients to create more effective dishes and gain an advantage.

  • Playable with mouse & keyboard or gamepad!

  • Supports 12 languages!

    Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian,

    French, German, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, Turkish

  • Choose your difficulty level!

    Easy, Normal, and Hard modes are available! (There's also a hidden difficulty level!)

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
